# SciELO South Africa

> > SciELO South Africa is a scholarly publishing platform operated by the Academy of Science of South Africa (ASSAf) providing open access to peer-reviewed South African journals.

The platform is part of the international SciELO network and managed by ASSAf's Scholarly Publishing Programme team based in Pretoria. It offers bibliographic search capabilities through the iAH interface developed by BIREME/PAHO/WHO.

## Key Topics

- SciELO SA

## Search and Discovery

- [iAH Search Interface](https://scielo.org.za/cgi-bin/wxis.exe/iah/?IsisScript=iah/iah.xis&base=title&fmt=iso.pft&lang=i): iAH bibliographic database search interface by BIREME/PAHO/WHO for searching SciELO SA journal content
